name: Northern Cardinal
facts: Call pattern: clear, slurred whistles such as "cheer, cheer, cheer" and "birdie, birdie, birdie." Females sing too, which is unusual among North American songbirds.
Habitat: dense shrubs, woodland edges and backyards. Pairs often stay together through the year.
Migration: none. It is the state bird of seven states, including Illinois and Indiana.
